dedupe_keys.name: measurement and evaluation of consequences of considering climate change effects in building standards

description: Measurement and Evaluation of Consequences of Considering Climate Change Effects in Building Standards is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Kristen Blowes, University of British Columbia (ubc.ca). Design standards in the United States, e.g., ASCE 7, rely on historic data to determine design loads for buildings and assume that distributions of design parameters are stationary. These limitations potentially leave buildings vulnerable to changing climate hazards. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: climate change, building standards, structural design, risk reduction, design loads. Published 2026-05-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
